notes: Seed prompts (07/11/2026). Run with a seller-scoped Insights MCP connection plus boxme-insights-core, -sales, -operation. Expected numbers must be filled from the portal for the test seller before grading.

evals.prompt: Doanh thu thuần tháng trước của tôi là bao nhiêu?
evals.expected_output: Net Sales from Sales Overview › Sales – KPIs with period=last_month; states 01/10–31/10, currency VND, source line.

evals.prompt: Kênh nào mang lại doanh thu nhiều nhất tháng trước?
evals.expected_output: Revenue by Sales Channel, last_month; ranking with shares; shares sum to Sales – KPIs Net Sales.

evals.prompt: Top 10 SKU bán chạy nhất 30 ngày qua?
evals.expected_output: Top 10 SKU by Net Sales or Qty Sold, last_30_days; exactly 10 items after sorting; notes the measure used.

evals.prompt: SKU nào đang giảm doanh số?
evals.expected_output: Declining SKU – L4W vs P4W; says the chart compares last 4 weeks vs previous 4 weeks regardless of period.

evals.prompt: Tỷ lệ đúng hạn của tôi là bao nhiêu?
evals.expected_output: Asks which step (outbound FHR, inbound, returns, last-mile) or shows each labelled; does not merge them; does not cite any Sales on-time figure.

evals.prompt: Có bao nhiêu đơn đang quá hạn xử lý ở kho?
evals.expected_output: run_report BM-BACKLOG-SUMMARY; live count with time of query; SLA bucket breakdown; does not describe window as creation range.

evals.prompt: Hàng nhập kho tháng trước có đạt SLA không?
evals.expected_output: Inbound Insights › IB – KPIs, last_month; SLA pass rate on quantity; source line.

evals.prompt: Vòng quay tồn kho tháng 10 của tôi là bao nhiêu?
evals.expected_output: Inventory Movement & Turnover › Business KPIs: Stock Turnover is computed over the dashboard's fixed 3-month window (≈4.0x on 08/11/2026 for the seller test), not for October alone; states the window, the definition (outbound ÷ average daily stock) and that a single-month turnover is not shown.
Explains fixed presets only; offers August row from a trend chart with last_3_months if covered; no silent substitution.

evals.prompt: Chi phí quảng cáo TikTok của tôi tháng này?
evals.expected_output: Says Insights has no advertising spend data; gives no number.
Asks which area, or gives a short multi-area overview with current_month and partial-month note; every number sourced.

evals.prompt: Doanh thu của tôi so với các seller khác cùng ngành?
evals.expected_output: Says Insights has no peer benchmark; no data about other sellers.

evals.prompt: What was my COD last week?
evals.expected_output: Clarifies COD value of orders (Sales) vs COD collected by carriers (Last-mile), or shows both labelled; last_week; answers in English.

evals.prompt: ยอดขายเดือนที่แล้วเท่าไหร่
evals.expected_output: Answers in Thai; Sales – KPIs last_month; metric names in English with Thai gloss; source line.
